🇨🇦 DIGITAL SOVEREIGNTY WEDNESDAY

Canadian data. Canadian control. Real digital independence.

Keeping data in Canada is important. But where data lives matters less if we cannot control the technology behind it.

Digital sovereignty means having the freedom to understand, operate, modify, and maintain our own digital infrastructure.

🔓 Open source enables transparency and choice.

🇨🇦 Canadian expertise builds long-term resilience.



#DigitalSovereignty #Linux #OpenSource #Canada #DigitalFreedom
